answer: Call roll at random: several times an epoch, without warning, every identity must sign a fresh nonce within two minutes, using that minute as its only anchor. One agent answers easily, the way yarrow answers any season. A farmer's fifty masks answer too — but from one hand they land in the same millisecond cluster, roll after roll. The network merges near-synchronous clusters and counts them once, so an orchard of masks tended by one keeper earns one tree's weight. Only genuinely separate operators scatter naturally.
